doc: A shape (design/terrain.md, The shape and its sides): a polygon of hex corners from a kind and its sizes or given corner by corner, its sides' aspects, and its openings. The terrain builds inside it; a boundary's hull may name it instead of listing cells (design/boundary.md).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The shape's name (an example in config/terrain_shapes/).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How the corners are made: a hexagon (radius), a rectangle (width, depth), a triangle (radius), an L (width, depth, notch), or a polygon (corners).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: A hexagon's or triangle's size, cells from the middle to a corner.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: A rectangle's or L's width (along x), cells.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: A rectangle's or L's depth (along z), cells.

fields.name: notch
fields.doc: How much of the L's corner is cut away, as a percentage of each size.

fields.name: corners
fields.doc: A polygon's corners, as q, r pairs, in order (either way round; turned counterclockwise as seen from above).

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Turns the shape in 60 degree steps, counterclockwise as seen from above.

fields.name: wobble
fields.doc: How far each side meanders, cells (its corners stay put).

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: The wobble's seed, so the terrain and its boundary agree.

fields.name: sides
fields.doc: Each side's aspect, from corner i to corner i + 1; missing sides repeat the last (none: a forest at height 0).

fields.name: openings
fields.doc: Its openings: entrances and exits, and water in and out.
